genes.name: HLA Class II DQ Alpha 1
genes.function: Alpha chain of HLA-DQ heterodimer; presents peptides to CD4+ T cells via MHC class II
genes.t1d_evidence: HLA-DQA1*0501 (DQA1 Arg52) on the DQ2 haplotype confers the strongest genetic risk for T1D. Heterozygous DQ2/DQ8 (DR3/DR4) genotype carries OR > 10 and accounts for ~30-40% of T1D patients.

genes.name: HLA Class II DQ Beta 1
genes.function: Beta chain of HLA-DQ heterodimer; determines peptide-binding specificity in the P9 pocket
genes.t1d_evidence: HLA-DQB1*0302 (DQ8, non-Asp57) and *0201 (DQ2) alleles are the primary T1D susceptibility determinants. Asp57-negative DQβ chains (Ala/Val/Ser at residue 57) fail to form a stabilizing salt bridge, altering peptide presentation to autoreactive T cells. DQB1*0602 is dominantly protective (OR ~0.03).

genes.name: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatase N22 (LYP)
genes.function: Lymphoid tyrosine phosphatase negatively regulating T cell receptor and B cell receptor signaling
genes.t1d_evidence: R620W (rs2476601) gain-of-function variant is the second-strongest T1D risk locus after HLA. The risk allele enhances LYP phosphatase activity, raising TCR signaling thresholds and impairing thymic negative selection of autoreactive T cells.

genes.name: Insulin (INS VNTR)
genes.function: Proinsulin precursor of insulin; thymic expression mediates central tolerance to insulin as autoantigen
genes.t1d_evidence: Variable Number Tandem Repeat (VNTR) upstream of INS regulates thymic insulin expression. Class I short VNTR alleles reduce thymic insulin transcription, impairing negative selection of insulin-reactive T cells. This is a primary T1D autoantigen locus.

genes.name: Cytotoxic T-Lymphocyte Associated Protein 4
genes.function: Inhibitory receptor on T cells that competes with CD28 for B7.1/B7.2 binding, dampening T cell activation
genes.t1d_evidence: CTLA4 polymorphisms (rs3087243, CT60) associated with T1D (OR 1.2-1.3). Reduced soluble CTLA-4 expression impairs peripheral T cell tolerance. Abatacept (CTLA4-Ig) slowed C-peptide decline in recent-onset T1D trials.

genes.name: Interleukin-2 Receptor Alpha Chain (CD25)
genes.function: High-affinity IL-2 receptor subunit; essential for regulatory T cell development, survival, and suppressive function
genes.t1d_evidence: IL2RA polymorphisms associated with T1D and multiple autoimmune diseases. Altered CD25 expression on Tregs and effector memory T cells disrupts the IL-2/Treg axis critical for islet-specific tolerance.

genes.name: Interferon Induced with Helicase C Domain 1 (MDA5)
genes.function: Cytoplasmic viral RNA sensor (RIG-I-like receptor) detecting dsRNA; triggers type I interferon production via MAVS-IRF3/IRF7
genes.t1d_evidence: IFIH1 polymorphisms (rs1990760, A946T) confer T1D risk with OR 1.15. Rare protective IFIH1 loss-of-function variants (OR ~0.5) suggest viral sensing via MDA5 contributes to islet autoimmunity initiation, possibly linking enteroviral infection to T1D.

genes.name: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatase Non-Receptor Type 2 (TC-PTP)
genes.function: Ubiquitously expressed phosphatase dephosphorylating JAK1/JAK3, STAT1/STAT3, and EGFR; negative regulator of cytokine and growth factor signaling
genes.t1d_evidence: PTPN2 polymorphisms associated with T1D and Crohn's disease. PTPN2 knockdown in β cells sensitizes them to TNF/IFN-γ-induced apoptosis via enhanced STAT1 signaling. Links inflammatory cytokine signaling to β cell destruction.

genes.name: Cathepsin H
genes.function: Lysosomal cysteine protease involved in proinsulin processing and MHC class II antigen processing in thymic epithelial cells
genes.t1d_evidence: CTSH polymorphisms associated with reduced CTSH expression in antigen-presenting cells. Lower cathepsin H activity impairs proinsulin degradation and MHC class II loading, altering the T cell repertoire for insulin autoantigen recognition.

genes.name: C-Type Lectin Domain Family 16 Member A
genes.function: Endosomal membrane protein regulating autophagy, mitophagy, and MHC class II antigen presentation in APCs
genes.t1d_evidence: CLEC16A intronic SNPs (rs12708716, rs2903692) consistently associated with T1D across GWAS. CLEC16A regulates autophagic flux and mitophagy; reduced expression may impair clearance of stressed mitochondria in β cells and alter antigen presentation.

genes.name: Interleukin-10
genes.function: Anti-inflammatory cytokine produced by Tregs, Tr1 cells, Bregs, and macrophages; suppresses Th1 and Th17 responses
genes.t1d_evidence: IL10 promoter polymorphisms (-1082 A/G, -592 C/A) associated with T1D susceptibility and age of onset. Reduced IL-10 production impairs counter-regulation of islet-destructive Th1 responses. IL-10-producing antigen-specific Tregs are being developed for T1D immunotherapy.

genes.name: GLIS Family Zinc Finger 3
genes.function: Krüppel-like zinc finger transcription factor essential for pancreatic β cell development, insulin gene transcription, and β cell survival
genes.t1d_evidence: GLIS3 polymorphisms (rs7020673) associated with T1D. GLIS3 directly regulates insulin gene expression and is critical for fetal islet development. Variants may reduce β cell functional reserve, lowering the threshold for autoimmune destruction.

genes.name: SH2B Adaptor Protein 3 (LNK)
genes.function: Adaptor protein negatively regulating JAK2 signaling downstream of cytokine and growth factor receptors
genes.t1d_evidence: SH2B3 rs3184504 (R262W) missense variant associated with T1D, celiac disease, and other autoimmune diseases. The variant alters LNK-mediated negative regulation of JAK-STAT signaling, affecting T cell and hematopoietic stem cell responses.

genes.name: Erb-B2 Receptor Tyrosine Kinase 3 (HER3)
genes.function: Receptor tyrosine kinase of the EGFR family; binds neuregulins and signals through PI3K-AKT pathway for cell survival
genes.t1d_evidence: ERBB3 polymorphisms (rs2292239) associated with T1D. ERBB3 signaling regulates β cell mass and survival; reduced ERBB3 expression may impair compensatory β cell proliferation during autoimmune stress.
genes.category: Growth Factor Signaling / β Cell Survival

genes.name: C1q and TNF Related 6 (CTRP6)
genes.function: Adipokine of the C1q/TNF superfamily; modulates complement activation, inflammation, and insulin sensitivity
genes.t1d_evidence: C1QTNF6 polymorphisms associated with T1D. CTRP6 regulates alternative complement pathway activity and inflammatory cytokine production; may link innate immune dysregulation to islet autoimmunity initiation.

genes.name: Ubiquitin-Associated and SH3 Domain-Containing A (STS-2/TULA-2)
genes.function: Phosphatase and adaptor protein that negatively regulates T cell receptor signaling and NF-κB activation
genes.t1d_evidence: UBASH3A polymorphisms (rs11203203, rs876498) associated with T1D. UBASH3A suppresses TCR-induced NF-κB signaling; reduced expression may lower T cell activation thresholds, promoting islet-reactive T cell responses.

genes.name: BTB and CNC Homology 2
genes.function: Transcription factor repressing B cell and T cell effector differentiation; promotes Treg development and maintains B cell tolerance
genes.t1d_evidence: BACH2 polymorphisms associated with T1D and multiple autoimmune diseases. BACH2 is a key guardian of immune homeostasis; it represses the effector program in T cells and prevents class switch recombination in autoreactive B cells. Reduced BACH2 function impairs immune tolerance checkpoints.

genes.name: Tumor Necrosis Factor Alpha
genes.function: Pro-inflammatory cytokine produced by macrophages and T cells; induces apoptosis, NF-κB activation, and amplifies autoimmune inflammation
genes.t1d_evidence: TNF promoter polymorphisms (-308 G/A) associated with T1D. TNF-α is directly cytotoxic to pancreatic β cells and synergizes with IL-1β and IFN-γ to induce β cell apoptosis. Anti-TNF therapy (golimumab) is under investigation for preserving β cell function in new-onset T1D.

genes.name: Tyrosine Kinase 2
genes.function: JAK family kinase mediating type I IFN, IL-12, and IL-23 signaling
genes.t1d_evidence: TYK2 mediates type I IFN and IL-12 in islet-infiltrating cells.

genes.name: Janus Kinase 1
genes.function: Tyrosine kinase mediating signaling for type I/II cytokine receptors
genes.t1d_evidence: JAK1 transduces IFN-γ/IL-6 signals cytotoxic to β cells.

genes.name: Forkhead Box P3
genes.function: Master transcription factor for regulatory T cell development and function
genes.t1d_evidence: FOXP3+ Tregs deficient in T1D. Major therapeutic strategy.

genes.name: Glutamic Acid Decarboxylase 2 (GAD65)
genes.function: Catalyzes GABA synthesis; primary autoantigen in T1D
genes.t1d_evidence: Primary T1D autoantigen. Anti-GAD65 antibodies in ~80% of patients.

genes.name: IA-2 / ICA512
genes.function: Transmembrane protein tyrosine phosphatase-like protein; major T1D autoantigen
genes.t1d_evidence: Key T1D autoantigen biomarker. Predicts progression with >90% specificity.

genes.name: Interleukin-2
genes.function: Essential cytokine for Treg survival and function
genes.t1d_evidence: IL-2 signaling impaired in T1D. Low-dose IL-2 therapy in Phase 2 trials.

genes.name: CD2
genes.function: Alefacept (LFA-3-Ig) binds CD2 on effector memory T cells, blocking CD2-CD58 costimulation and depleting pathogenic memory T cells via NK cell-mediated ADCC
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: CD20 (MS4A1 / B-lymphocyte antigen CD20)
genes.function: B cell surface protein involved in B cell activation, proliferation, and calcium signaling
genes.disease_evidence: Target of B cell depletion therapies (rituximab, obinutuzumab) used clinically in refractory SLE.

genes.name: CD3 (TCR/CD3 Complex)
genes.function: Teplizumab is a humanized anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody that modulates the TCR/CD3 complex, inducing T cell anergy and expanding regulatory T cells
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: CD80
genes.function: Abatacept (CTLA4-Ig) binds CD80 (B7.1) on APCs, blocking CD28-mediated T cell costimulation and reducing islet-reactive T cell activation
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: CD86
genes.function: Abatacept (CTLA4-Ig) binds CD86 (B7.2) on APCs, blocking CD28-mediated T cell costimulation and reducing islet-reactive T cell activation
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: Glutamic Acid Decarboxylase 65 (GAD65)
genes.function: GAD-alum delivers recombinant GAD65 autoantigen with alum adjuvant, inducing GAD65-specific immune tolerance via Treg induction and Th2 deviation
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: IL12B
genes.function: Ustekinumab targets the shared p40 subunit of IL-12, blocking the IL-12/IFN-γ Th1 differentiation pathway implicated in islet autoimmunity
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: IL23A
genes.function: Ustekinumab targets the shared p40 subunit of IL-23, blocking the IL-23/IL-17 Th17 differentiation pathway implicated in islet autoimmunity
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: Insulin Receptor (INSR)
genes.function: Insulin glargine is a long-acting insulin analog that binds and activates the insulin receptor, providing 24-hour basal insulin replacement
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.

genes.name: L-type Calcium Channel (CACNA1C)
genes.function: Verapamil blocks L-type calcium channels in β cells, paradoxically reducing TXNIP expression and protecting β cells from ER stress and NLRP3 inflammasome-induced apoptosis
genes.disease_evidence: Curated relationship endpoint for graph integrity.
